spec.control: constant TLT weight equal to realised average exposure (approx. 0.14 = 3 held sessions / ~21 sessions per month); implemented here as a fixed benchmark_targets weight re-applied at the same two decision times, which approximates but does not exactly reproduce the daily-rebalanced C_EXP control used in research/tsy_month_end/evaluate.py
spec.decision_schedule_note: Two targets decisions per month: entry (targets={'TLT':1.0}) recorded before the close of the 4th-to-last NYSE session, executed at that session's close; exit (targets={'TLT':0.0}) recorded before the close of the last NYSE session of the month, executed at that session's close. adapters.register_generic's decision_rule only supports 'any_session' (no date check) or 'first_session_of_month'; neither validates 'Nth-to-last session of month', so the operator (not the adapter) is responsible for computing and using the correct dates. See reports/forward_audit/proposed_adapter_diff_month_end_window.txt for a minimal, unapplied code addition that would let the adapter validate this schedule the way it already validates first_session_of_month.
spec.decision_time: any time before the close of the 4th-to-last session of the month for the entry, and any time before the close of the last session of the month for the exit (the calendar is known in advance; the rule uses no market data to decide)
